commentary: The GPU rental waterfall is steep and bifurcated: Vast.ai marketplace spot rates (H100 $0.67/hr, A100 $0.47/hr) sit 5-8x below specialist-cloud on-demand medians, while hyperscalers charge 2-4x the specialist floor. Depreciation divergence is the key risk flag: Meta, Microsoft, Google and Oracle all extended server lives to 5.5-6 years just as AI capex surged, collectively suppressing tens of billions in annual depreciation, yet Amazon uniquely reversed a subset back to 5 years in Jan 2025 citing AI hardware turnover pace—a direct repudiation of peers' accounting. CoreWeave's bonds trading at distressed levels (15% yields, sub-80 cents) signal credit markets are pricing GPU collateral and revenue backlog very differently than equity bulls, and the $176B Burry depreciation-understatement estimate (disputed but unrefuted in filings) implies reported AI operating margins may be 20%+ overstated through 2028 as the capex wave hits income statements.
